heroHeadline: Al-Sharaa Tells UN Israel Must Leave Golan as Depot Blasts Kill 11
heroSubtitle: President Ahmad al-Sharaa used his September 23, 2026 UN General Assembly address to demand Israel withdraw from the Golan Heights, citing 500 Israeli strikes, 1,200+ incursions and 300 detentions in Syria since Assad's fall; Defense Minister Israel Katz rejected the demand, calling the Golan 'an integral, eternal part of Israel.' The speech came days after a wave of unexplained ammunition depot explosions — 11 soldiers killed near Deir ez-Zor on September 19 and four people wounded near Aleppo on September 21 — brought Syria's tally of such blasts since Assad's December 2024 fall to at least 16, with analysts split between poor storage and possible sabotage.
